hostel.text: 8.2.2 Hostel Fees (Per Year, excluding mess security): Rent 10,000; Electricity 5,000; Hostel Fund 5,000; Student Fund 1,000; Total 21,000. Securities (refundable) 12,500.

government_all.notes: College fee total 31,500 per year (tuition 24,000 + depreciation 5,000 + athletic 1,000 + student fund 1,500). Conflict: token money for a Government Medical College is 39,000, described as 'Equivalent to full first-year tuition fee (excluding hostel fee and security)' (§6.2.1, p.20). AIQ seats not covered (state prospectus). Students with >40% disability are not charged any fee (AMRU notification 15.05.2024).
